description: Customer Experience Manager at SaaS company with full details
input:
Title: Customer Experience Manager
Company: Northwind Labs
URL: https://northwindlabs.example/careers/cx-manager

Northwind Labs is looking for a Customer Experience Manager to lead customer experience initiatives across our mid-market segment. You'll own the end-to-end customer journey, drive NPS improvements, and build scalable CX programs that delight customers.

Requirements:
- 6+ years in customer experience, customer success, or related roles
- Deep experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and CRM workflows
- Proficiency in customer analytics (GA4, Looker, or Tableau)
- Experience running NPS/CSAT programs (Medallia or similar)
- Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration
- Excellent written and verbal communication

Compensation: $135,000 - $160,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US)
notes: Standard full-info CX Manager listing. Tests basic extraction with all fields present. Manager title -> senior per management-track rules.

description: Product Manager at AI company, missing compensation
input:
Title: Product Manager
Company: Cerebro AI
URL: https://cerebro.example/careers/pm

Cerebro AI is looking for a Product Manager to shape the future of our enterprise AI products. You'll work closely with research and engineering to translate cutting-edge AI capabilities into product experiences that customers love.

What you'll do:
- Define product strategy and roadmap for enterprise features
- Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform priorities
- Partner with design and engineering to ship high-quality experiences
- Analyze usage data to identify opportunities and measure impact

Qualifications:
- 5+ years of product management experience
- Experience with AI/ML products or platforms
- Strong analytical skills (SQL, product analytics tools)
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management

Location: Austin, TX (hybrid - 3 days in office)
notes: IC PM role -- 'Product Manager' defaults to senior per crossover rules. No compensation listed. Tests missing comp handling and PM seniority mapping.

description: Director of Customer Experience at SaaS company -- principal seniority
input:
Title: Director of Customer Experience
Company: Globex Software
URL: https://globex.example/careers/director-cx

Globex Software is seeking a Director of Customer Experience to lead our global CX strategy. You'll own the voice-of-customer program, drive CX transformation, and manage a team of 12 across support, success, and operations.

Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the CX strategy across all customer segments
- Build and lead the CX team (12 direct and indirect reports)
- Own NPS, CSAT, and customer health metrics
- Partner with Product and Engineering to close the customer feedback loop
- Drive CX technology roadmap (Salesforce, Medallia, Gainsight)

Requirements:
- 10+ years in customer experience or customer success leadership
- 5+ years managing CX teams of 8+
- Deep expertise with CX platforms (Salesforce, Medallia, Gainsight)
- Strong data-driven decision making (Looker, Tableau, or Power BI)
- Experience with B2B SaaS customer lifecycle management

Compensation: $165,000 - $200,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US/Canada)
notes: Tests 'Director' -> principal mapping. Title may be normalized -- both acceptable.

description: Director of Customer Operations at fintech firm -- principal, hybrid
input:
Title: Director, Customer Operations
Company: Meridian Financial
URL: https://meridianfin.example/careers/director-customer-ops

Meridian Financial is hiring a Director of Customer Operations to lead operational excellence across our client services organization. You'll own the operating model, scale repeatable processes, and partner cross-functionally to improve the client lifecycle.

Responsibilities:
- Lead a customer operations team of 10-15
- Build and scale operational frameworks and playbooks
- Drive process improvement and change management
- Partner with product, support, and success on the client journey
- Report operational metrics to senior leadership

Requirements:
- 10+ years in customer operations, customer success, or service operations
- Experience leading operations teams at scale
- Strong process design and change management expertise
- Proficiency with Salesforce and operational analytics
- Willingness to travel up to 20%

Compensation: $150,000 - $185,000 + performance bonus
Location: New York, NY (hybrid - 2 days in office)
notes: Tests Director -> principal mapping. Domain could be fintech or financial services. Performance bonus is not equity.

description: Junior Support Coordinator at large enterprise -- negative match
input:
Title: Junior Support Coordinator
Company: MegaMart Global
URL: https://megamart.example/careers/jr-support-coordinator

MegaMart Global (50,000+ employees) is looking for a Junior Support Coordinator to support our North American e-commerce customer support team.

Responsibilities:
- Respond to customer tickets in Zendesk
- Update order records in our internal tools
- Track support metrics in Google Sheets
- Escalate issues to senior support staff

Requirements:
- 1-2 years of customer support experience
- Familiarity with Zendesk and ticketing systems
- Basic Excel and Google Sheets skills
- Strong attention to detail

Compensation: $45,000 - $55,000
Location: On-site, Columbus OH (no remote options available)
notes: Multiple dealbreakers: junior seniority, onsite, large enterprise. Tests Coordinator -> junior mapping and explicit 'no remote' -> onsite.

description: Customer Success Lead at developer-tools company -- staff seniority, no comp
input:
Title: Customer Success Lead
Company: Forge DevTools
URL: https://forgedevtools.example/careers/cs-lead

Forge DevTools builds developer productivity tooling for engineering teams. We're hiring a Customer Success Lead to own the post-sale relationship for our growing enterprise accounts.

What you'll do:
- Lead onboarding and adoption for enterprise customers
- Own renewal and expansion targets for your book of business
- Build playbooks to reduce churn and drive product adoption
- Partner with product to surface customer feedback

Qualifications:
- 7+ years in customer success or account management
- Experience with Gainsight or a comparable CS platform
- Strong analytical skills (SQL a plus)
- Excellent stakeholder management

Location: Seattle, WA (hybrid - in-office Tue/Wed/Thu)
notes: Tests 'Lead' without 'Manager' -> staff mapping. No compensation mentioned. 3-day in-office with specific days -> hybrid.
